[short] skip
[!git] skip

env BOLERO_PROXY=direct

bolero list -m vcs-test.golang.org/git/odd-tags.git@latest
stdout -count=1 '^.'
stdout '^vcs-test.golang.org/git/odd-tags.git v0.1.1-0.20220223184835-9d863d525bbf$'

bolero list -m -versions vcs-test.golang.org/git/odd-tags.git
stdout -count=1 '^.'
stdout '^vcs-test.golang.org/git/odd-tags.git$'  # No versions listed — the odd tags are filtered out.
